responsibility: This file implements GCC’s language-independent tree attribute engine used by front ends and the middle end to register, canonicalize, validate, merge, compare, and apply declaration and type attributes. It owns the runtime attribute tables for common, language, target, and scoped namespaces; performs lookup and duplicate/exclusion checks; drives attribute handlers and diagnostics for wrong placement or argument forms; constructs attribute-qualified decl/type variants; and provides attr_access parsing and pretty-print support for access-related attributes that feed diagnostics and optimization reasoning.
same_name_distinction: Implements the shared attribute subsystem declared in gcc/attribs.h: it owns the runtime attribute tables and executable logic for registration, lookup, validation, merging, and application, rather than the header’s API/type declarations and inline helpers.
